annotations.title: Capture a page's own API calls (XHR/fetch)

description: Load a web page in a real browser through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return the JSON its own API calls received: every XHR/fetch response whose URL contains `capture_xhr` (a fragment such as '/api/search'), in order, with status and body. Use it when a site renders from a JSON API that refuses direct requests: the page makes the call, so it succeeds. Optional `steps` make the page fire the call (a search, 'load more'); steps act on the website and run once. Up to 20 responses; the page HTML is not returned. Billed as one request; when the site refuses every matching call (403/429) the call fails and is free.

capture_xhr.description: A fragment of the API URL the page calls, e.g. '/api/search' (plain substring).

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

steps.description: Optional browser actions that make the page fire the call. Runs once.

selector.description: CSS selector the action targets (required for wait_for/click/type/select).

value.description: Action payload: text to type/select, text for wait_for_text, a key name for press_key (e.g. 'Enter'), milliseconds for wait, or 'bottom'/pixels for scroll.

name: capture_xhr
